discards.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails on its own timing conjunct as well. It requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence 'at or before' the arrived event, and the earliest qualifying in-geofence fix on the trace is 23:42:21, which post-dates the trip record's 23:42:10 marker; the trace jumps from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21, so the 186-second gap swallows the moment of entry and no fix sits at the marker at all. ruling.explanation:
This case cannot be decided on the present record and goes to a human reviewer. The SGD 6.00 no-show fee is held — not collected and not refunded — while that review is pending.

WHY THE FEE CANNOT STAND OR FALL AUTOMATICALLY. Under POL-NS-01 the fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 480-second dwell (the AIRPORT minimum), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The only artifact that measures that dwell is EV-GPS-00210, the driver-device trace, and it is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) (the device clock runs 228 s ahead of the server — over the 90 s limb, so no fix can be safely matched to the 23:42:10 arrival event) and under POL-NS-08(b) (a 186 s sampling gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry; coverage is 22.8%; and the trace stops at 23:46:36, 149 s before the 23:49:05 cancellation). Read at face value the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell to cancellation is 404 s, 76 s short of the minimum; corrected for the recorded skew the same fix maps to 23:38:33 server time and the dwell is 632 s, comfortably over it. The one stretch of the trace that would choose between those readings — the missing 23:39–23:42 fixes — is exactly what is missing. The deciding fact is therefore established in neither direction, and under POL-NS-08 the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND; because the deciding fact rests only on evidence impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(b), the case escalates under POL-NS-09 rather than issuing that partial ruling. EV-GPS-00210 carries weight 0.25 on issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

THE TRIP RECORD DOES NOT BREAK THE TIE — IT DEEPENS IT. EV-TRIP-00210 is impaired at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: its arrived_at of 23:42:10 and its implied 6.9-minute wait cannot be reconciled with the trace, and the pre-pass records that nothing in the bundle resolves which source is right. It is not independent corroboration of a shortfall; it is the other half of the contradiction. Because the two admissible records conflict directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves it (POL-NS-05 cannot run, since the skew exceeds 90 s), POL-NS-09(b) is engaged as well as POL-NS-09(a) and (e).

TO THE RIDER. Your POL-NS-06 shortfall argument (the 255-second qualifying run, and the 404-second face-value dwell) and your POL-NS-01(c) argument (the record's own 6.9 minutes, or 414–415 seconds) are plausible on the trace's face value, but neither survives the impairment: the trace is unsafe to read either way because of the 228 s clock skew, and the skew-corrected reading is over the required minimum. The absence of rider_track is expressly NEUTRAL under POL-NS-04(c), not a finding in your favour, and the rider's presence test simply could not be run.

TO THE DRIVER. Your POL-NS-01(d) point is good only in part: RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three termination codes limb (d) recognises and there is no boarding event, but limb (d) also requires termination AT OR AFTER the moment the required dwell elapsed, and that timing conjunct cannot be confirmed on this record. Your POL-NS-07 point is arithmetically correct — 2 no-show terminations against 156 completed trips is a rate of 0.013, so the anti-farming guard does not trip — but POL-NS-07 compensation presupposes POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, which it is not, and on an escalation nothing is paid out. Your account of waiting 'more than eight minutes' is evidence, but it is a self-serving assertion, not an admission or a contemporaneous record, and it does not resolve the conflict between the two instruments.

CONFIDENCE. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped by the evidence the ruling actually rests on. The dwell fact is carried by the impaired trace (0.25) and the impaired trip record (0.40); treating those two independent sources together, the cap is their maximum, 0.4, and the bundle mean is only context. That is below the platform floor of 0.70 read from this policy, so POL-NS-09(a) is independently triggered.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Reconstruct the true server-time entry into the Changi T1 arrival geofence — the device clock offset and the unsampled 23:39:15–23:42:21 fixes must be worked out — and determine whether the driver completed the 480-second dwell before cancelling at 23:49:05. If he did not, the fee is refunded in full to the rider; if he did, the fee stands and the driver's POL-NS-07 compensation falls to be assessed. No referral is issued: no clause applicable to these facts directs one (POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist).
